findings.highlight: "To summon a Heroic Spirit, one must possess a symbol that has some connection to that Heroic Spirit. As you had no knowledge of being Master, nor any experience as a mage, you must have had some sort of connection to me.
findings.evidenceJa: 「英霊を呼ぶには、英霊に縁があるシンボルがなければならない。マスターとしての知識もなく、魔術師としても未熟だったシロウが私を呼ぶには、それを補ってあまりある“接点”がなければならない。
findings.governingReading: He is immature as a mage, and the link must more than compensate for his deficits as a summoner.
findings.explanation: An immature mage with an exceptionally compensating link becomes an inexperienced mage with some connection.

findings.highlight: The weakness was only a fleeting dream.
findings.evidenceJa: この弱さは、ある少女が見た、一時の理想郷だったのだと—
findings.governingReading: The weakness is one girl’s briefly imagined utopia, with dream supplied by ruby.
findings.explanation: A girl’s temporary utopia becomes only a fleeting dream.

findings.highlight: I'm trying my best to suppress my feelings for her and convince myself that this is the right thing to do.
findings.evidenceJa: 嫌だ、と崩れそうになるまなじりを、懸命に抑えるコトで精一杯だ。
findings.governingReading: He can only desperately hold back the eye corners about to give way in a protest of no.
findings.explanation: Holding back collapsing eye corners becomes persuading himself the choice is right.
